Dental and Annual Checkup Preparation Notes

Annual fasting blood panel appointments at St. Claire Outpatient Clinic require strictly zero calories and only plain water for ten hours prior to the 07:30 blood draw. Black coffee, juice, and throat lozenges break the fasting window and can skew triglyceride and glucose measurements.

Bring the laminated lab referral slip and a printed list of daily supplements to Reception Desk B on the second floor at least fifteen minutes before your scheduled slot. Dr. Reyes reviews lab results every Wednesday and Friday afternoon between 13:30 and 16:30 in Consultation Room 204.

For routine dental scaling and panoramic X-rays at Molar Care Studio, avoid wearing metal earrings or hairpins, and take regular morning blood pressure medication with a small sip of water as usual. Free basement validation stamps cover the first two hours of clinic parking if presented at the ground-floor cashier.
